# uptimeify_monitoring_locations (Data Source)

Countries with at least one active check worker. Use `country_codes` for `allowed_check_country_codes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_monitoring_locations" "all" {}

output "check_countries" {
  value = data.uptimeify_monitoring_locations.all.country_codes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `countries` (Attributes List) Per country, sorted by code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--countries))
- `country_codes` (List of String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, sorted.
- `id` (String) Always `monitoring-locations`.

<a id="nestedatt--countries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `countries`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
- `locations` (Number) Check locations in the country.
- `workers` (Number) Active check workers in the country.
